items.text: Steelers downgraded WR Michael Pittman Jr. to OUT (foot) for Sunday.
items.implication: PIT WR volume to Metcalf/others; Levitan notes Germie Bernard look.

items.text: ETR Sunday injuries: OUT/DOUBTFUL Bowers/Collins/Flowers/Lane/Murray/Jennings/AJ Brown/Darnold/Penix/Tua/etc; Q McConkey/Olave/Burrow(said playing)/Pittman/Harvey/Black/McMillan; IN Henderson/Pierce/Coker/Kamara/Tucker.
items.implication: Key changes drive projections; beneficiaries for outs.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey questionable (ribs); limited practice Friday after two DNPs.
items.why: Ribs; biggest slate injury per Levitan, impacts Herbert.
items.implication: GTD; Johnston boost if out. Game 4pm ET.

items.text: Texans ruled out WR Nico Collins due to hamstring injury for Sunday vs Bengals.
items.why: Hamstring; DNP all week after Wednesday injury.
items.implication: HOU WR volume opens; Schultz TE stream up; Hutchinson/Boutte deep flex.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers listed doubtful for Sunday vs Saints (hamstring).
items.implication: Plan without; BAL WR crumbs to Bateman etc.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers doubtful vs Chargers (knee); limited Friday after no prior practice.
items.why: Knee post-surgery; game-time test possible but prepare out.

items.text: Joe Burrow good to go / expected to play despite Q (back); said he's playing, full Friday.
items.why: Back tightness; adamant he plays, coach confirms.

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua missed Friday practice (hip); status uncertain for MNF vs Giants. Donald plans to play.
items.why: Hip added late; extra day but concerning.
items.implication: Monitor Saturday; Adams elevated if out. Have MNF escape.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson IN for debut; Patriots desperate for playmakers (AJ Brown IR), potential 10+ touches vs Stevenson. Nice upcoming schedule.
items.why: Ready to go; explosive need with Brown out.
items.implication: Monitor split; flex upside in debut.

items.text: Ladd McConkey (ribs) biggest injury on slate; affects many projections including Justin Herbert. BAL/HOU/NE down to WR crumbs. CMC bump off W1 usage; Black status matters.
items.implication: Fade Herbert slightly if McConkey out; monitor Black for CMC.

items.text: Kenneth Walker LOVE: 24%+ tgt share/util W1 (tied lead, 40% routes), 74% snaps; Indy gave 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry. RB1 overall range.
Ashton Jeanty LOVE (99 util W1, 19% tgt last 10); Bucky Irving LOVE (26% tgt/RZ all, out-routed Gainwell).
Justin Jefferson LOVE (37% tgt Wentz, hist 18 PPG w/ him); DeVonta Smith LOVE (27% tgt/13.7 aDOT, TEN soft); Dak LOVE (home/smash vs WAS).

Travis Etienne HATE (Kamara return squeezes; matched Miller rushes, air-heavy); Marvin Harrison Jr HATE (8% tgt share W1, 0 RZ, SEA tough). Brian Thomas Jr HATE (DEN perimeter lock + shoulder). Harold Fannin HATE (low 14% tgt).
items.implication: Sit/fade; Kamara IN further hurts ETN.
items.opportunity: Negative for listed; positive Kamara return.
